name: Waypoint Woods
subject: AI Planning
description: Walk forest trails where Kit plans each step to a goal: how a program searches for a route, writes a problem down, guesses the distance left, ignores what actions undo, and keeps only states with something new.
bigFact: A world described by just 100 yes-or-no facts can be in up to about 10 to the power 30 different states, yet a width-1 search keeps at most 100 of them.
